RagShortTexts: The Colonna aristocracy rallied around their column emblem, anchoring Ghibelline resistance.

Variants.Content: The House of Colonna flew a solitary marble column on red, spearheading Roman Ghibelline defiance from the cyclopean heights of Palestrina. Fiercely imperial, they countered papal dominance across Lazio and the Tiber bridges.
Colonna castles mocked papal excommunications, housing veteran mercenaries loyal solely to family patriarchs.
